summary.name: Enlitic
summary.one_liner: Enlitic is an AI-driven data company that standardizes, anonymizes and migrates medical imaging data so it is correct, complete and consistent.
use_cases: migrating imaging data during healthcare mergers and acquisitions
cleaning radiology worklists and hanging protocols
preparing imaging data for AI and research
summary.what_it_does:
Enlitic describes an AI-driven data refinery that takes inconsistent or mislabeled medical imaging data and makes it correct, complete and consistent. Its stated process has three steps: assess and standardize the data, automate and migrate it with minimal disruption, then validate and optimize it into insight-ready form. The company says it also anonymizes imaging data and supports migration during healthcare M&A. The page says the work is aimed at radiologists, IT staff, executives and researchers. It mentions outcomes such as cleaner worklists and fixed hanging protocols, but gives no technical specifications.</what_it_does>
